Function of Space Object: Hayasat-1 is an educational and technology demonstration mission. Within implementation of the mission, space engineering (from satellite component testing to satellite integration) has been enhanced and satellite operation capabilities will be developed. The communication system of Hayasat-1 transmits a part from the "Praise of the Partridge" song composed by eminent Armenian musicologist Komitas, who is considered the founder of the Armenian national school of music. The satellite also carries an internally developed and manufactured secondary payload, measurements of which will provide data on the satellite's rotations, position and motion.
